report.explanation: Gateway telemetry for the alert window is healthy: checkout span OK at 65ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 77ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. This contradicts the checkout error-rate and latency alert and does not establish any bounded root cause. Only gateway evidence is available; downstream services in the topology are unobserved. Handing off for downstream and time-series evidence.
